'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Brad Eier DS Coruscant: Imperial City''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brad Eier]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Name on sheet:''' Eier
* '''Deck name:''' dont ban me larson
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
